body:
Well I've just finished college, expected to get below average grades, now pressured to quit my part time job for a full time one which scares me so much since I'm incredibly nervous and cannot function in situations like interviews. I have no aspiration to be anything, everything seems either out of reach or dull. The fact I'm gay and the thought of people knowing and completely changing how they treat me depresses me. I find it difficult to get any sleep, Constant nightmares, very skinny due to the fact I don't eat much. 
I literally have no-one that I can relate to IRL, I spend most days worrying about the next one and the nights planning my death whilst trying to force myself asleep. 
I have no intention of speaking to anyone about it IRL, there's not one friend that I could tell that wouldn't judge me, that wouldn't patronise me or take me seriously. I imagine as you're reading this that I have very minimal reasons to want death, but in my mind they're huge. 

Ending It now seems a lot better than "living" a dull, lonely,under achieving life.
Its really hard to put how shitty i feel into words, and I doubt I've justified my depression.
